label: Last checked at 8 a.m. ET
title: Today In Golf
summary: A 30-second briefing on today's biggest golf stories.

items.headline: Scheffler dominates FedEx St. Jude
items.text: Scottie Scheffler leads the 2026 FedEx St. Jude Championship by eight shots at 17-under 263, marking the event’s largest margin of victory in 68 years and his 21st PGA Tour title.

items.headline: Rory McIlroy struggles at St. Jude
items.text: Rory McIlroy finished 66th, 25 shots behind Scheffler, admitting he "felt lost" and worried he had "lost" his golf swing during the tournament.
